T: › to make a sound quieter and less clear
使（聲音）變微弱（或低沉）；消（聲）
› to make something less strong or clear
› to wear thick warm clothes in order to keep warm
（為保暖而用厚衣物）圍裹，裹住；蒙住

example: The house has double-glazed windows to muffle the noise of aircraft.

I was muffled up against the cold in a scarf and hat.
我裹上圍巾、戴上帽子以抵禦寒冷。
